meta.name: asana-automation
meta.description: Automate Asana tasks via Rube MCP (Composio): tasks, projects, sections, teams, workspaces. Always search tools first for current schemas.

copy.tagline: 自动管理 Asana 中的任务、项目和团队
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常在 Asana 中手动创建和更新任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate Asana tasks, projects, and teams
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently create and update tasks in Asana manually

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过 Rube MCP 操作 Asana，包括创建/搜索任务、管理项目和板块、查看团队和用户，以及批量执行操作。
howto.when: 当你要求管理 Asana 任务、项目、板块、团队或用户时触发。例如：创建任务、列出项目、添加任务到板块。

say.text: 在 Asana 的“市场”项目中创建一个名为“设计评审”的任务。
say.note: Claude 会调用工具创建任务并添加到指定项目。

say.text: 列出 Asana 中“产品”工作区的所有项目。
say.note: Claude 会获取工作区 ID 并列出项目。

say.text: 把任务“修复登录 bug”移到“进行中”板块。
say.note: Claude 会查找任务和板块，然后移动任务。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can operate Asana via Rube MCP: create/search tasks, manage projects and sections, view teams and users, and execute bulk operations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to manage Asana tasks, projects, sections, teams, or users. For example: create a task, list projects, add a task to a section.

say_en.text: Create a task named 'Design Review' in the 'Marketing' project in Asana.
say_en.note: Claude will call tools to create the task and add it to the project.

say_en.text: List all projects in the 'Product' workspace in Asana.
say_en.note: Claude will get the workspace ID and list projects.

say_en.text: Move the task 'Fix login bug' to the 'In Progress' section.
say_en.note: Claude will find the task and section, then move the task.
